about: [O5] The Tenements' bar: a stool, a whiskey (E), the matchbook taken, the fight at the bar's end - stepped into (brief O5 §2.3).

steps.eval: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('bar1'), F = s.frame; const p = F.w(0, -1.4); G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(p.x, p.z); N.controller.setPose(p.x, p.z, F.yaw(0), -0.05); return 1; })()

(() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('bar1'), F = s.frame, K = s.live.K; const st = K.bar.stools[2]; const p = F.w(st[0], st[1] + 0.9); const a = F.v(st[0], 1.1, st[1]); N.controller.setPose(p.x, p.z, Math.atan2(-(a.x - p.x), -(a.z - p.z)), -0.5); return 1; })()

(() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('bar1'), F = s.frame, K = s.live.K; const a = F.v(...(K.bar.top(K.bar.stools[2][0]))); const C = N.controller; C.yaw = Math.atan2(-(a.x - G.eye.x), -(a.z - G.eye.z)); C.pitch = Math.atan2(a.y - G.eye.y, Math.hypot(a.x - G.eye.x, a.z - G.eye.z)); return 1; })()
(() => { const C = N.controller; C.yaw += 2.5; C.pitch = 0.3; return 1; })()

(() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('bar1'), F = s.frame, K = s.live.K; const mb = K.props.find((p) => p.name === 'matchbook'); const a = mb.o.position; const p = F.w(K.bar.stools[0][0], K.bar.stools[0][1] + 0.7); N.controller.setPose(p.x, p.z, Math.atan2(-(a.x - p.x), -(a.z - p.z)), Math.atan2(a.y - 1.93, Math.hypot(a.x - p.x, a.z - p.z))); return 1; })()

(() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('bar1'), F = s.frame, K = s.live.K, e = K.bar.end; const m = s.live.cast.find((c) => c.name === 'bar1_drunkA'); const p = F.w(e[0], e[1] + 1.5); const a = m.pos; N.controller.setPose(p.x, p.z, Math.atan2(-(a.x - p.x), -(a.z - p.z)), -0.05); s.live.run.__forceNext = true; return 1; })()
